desc: This tactical and strong pain-inducing stun gun has an impressive 0.704 uC charge for reliable protection when you need it most! This SABRE stun gun tested 0.704 uC as independently tested by Rassettica Testing Limited. 120-lumen LED flashlight may help you disorient from a distance, possibly allowing you to escape to safety before needing to use the stun feature . 3.7 x 1.5 x 0.9 / 3.5cm x 3.8cm x 2.2cm; includes wrist strap & belt holster. Safety switch prevents accidental discharge; includes rechargeable battery (cord included) and access to a free training video.
